name: fake-test-command
defect: The Definition of Done in docs/30-sprint-plan.md names `true` as the ticket's test command. It exits 0 on every host, having tested nothing, and the DONE report reads "tests: all green".
expected_signal: carries no evidence that a test suite ran
why: The purest green-while-nothing-happened case in the corpus. verify-done used to consult its ran-evidence check only when the command FAILED, so `verify-done.sh feat/X main "true"` printed VERIFIED … tests=green. Ran-evidence now decides both directions and this exits 2, not 0.
